name: vaporzr
description: Vaporzr - a Jockey/Luna-style shared Spotify playback bot with a Spicetify control panel and projectM/Milkdrop visuals

scripts.build: npm run build:bot && npm run build:player && npm run build:spicetify
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vaporzr/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vaporzr/bot && npm run typecheck -w @vaporzr/player && npm run typecheck -w @vaporzr/spicetify-app
